sections.content: Combine sequencing expressions with cooking vocabulary. Use the pretérito perfecto for completed actions and *antes* de / *después* de + infinitive to show their order.

items.spanish: Hemos lavado las manos antes de cocinar.
items.english: We have washed our hands before cooking.

items.spanish: Hemos cortado las verduras antes de preparar la salsa.
items.english: We have cut the vegetables before preparing the sauce.

items.spanish: Hemos mezclado los ingredientes después de cortar las verduras.
items.english: We have mixed the ingredients after cutting the vegetables.

items.spanish: Hemos servido la comida después de cocinar.
items.english: We have served the food after cooking.

sections.content: The verb after *antes* de and *después* de stays in the infinitive: antes de *cocinar*, después de cocinar.
